name: Syslog Watcher
description: Provides an admin back-office report to browse and paginate the events written by core Syslog, parsing the log file into a dblog-style table.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 Log viewer for your web server.

 With this module you can have access to events logged by the Syslog module.

 Requirements 
 Syslog module have to use a specific file for the Drupal log and this file has to be readable by the webserver user.

 Configuration 
 Configure in Administration » Configuration » Development » Logging and errors :

 
 Define which file to read. 
 If you have changed the separator used on the syslog format, you also have to configure it.
